verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a SaaS remote-support product that stores session data and AI-generated session summaries, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers audit logs, AI session summaries and an API, but nothing documents user- or admin-configurable retention periods or deletion of data. Community items discuss stored credentials and billing, not retention controls, so they are not relevant here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
